title: Reference-weighted quantum likelihood spectrum is not operationally sufficient
statement: There exist faithful quantum state pairs (rho_theta,sigma) with identical sigma-weighted spectral measure of L_theta=sigma^{-1/2}rho_theta sigma^{-1/2} but different trace distance. Therefore that one-dimensional spectral profile cannot be a sufficient PDT-native quantum composition object.
surviving_requirement: A viable nonclassical PDT distinction/composition object must retain noncommutative orientation/compatibility information beyond a scalar or one-dimensional weighted spectrum.
